implementation.scope: Separate fixed-geometry cached-forward implementation of the retained open fixture, not a semantic change to the model or its P/K/F/S schedule.
implementation.source_composition: Compile the incremental translation unit instead of profile_forward.cpp; it includes the unchanged original implementation and reuses its exact internal arithmetic helpers. Never link both translation units.
implementation.cache: Retain every key/value slot, causal input symbol, cursor, initialization flag and last F32 distribution. Full checkpoints retain these alongside all parameters, optimizer second moments and compensation, detached memory, scheduler, byte adapter and pending state.
implementation.masked_attention: Preserve the 72-slot softmax and zero-symbol future K/V placeholders. The original exponential floor can give masked positions nonzero weights.
implementation.invalidation: Clear all K/V rows after each full-model update; rebuild from the detached memory and decoded prefix before prediction.
implementation.restore: Recompute and compare every cached byte against restored parameters, memory and input history; reject disagreement, never silently repair.
implementation.archive_identity: GMAC model tag retained only for exact cross-decoding; incremental model checkpoint magic OPFI differs from reference OPFX.
implementation.reference_state_projection: Diagnostic model/optimizer/memory comparison excludes incremental cache; never use this projection as the complete incremental checkpoint or state witness.
